headword: {心筋梗塞|しんきんこうそく}

definitions.explanation: A serious medical condition in which blood flow to the heart muscle is blocked, causing tissue damage. One of the leading causes of death worldwide.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{心筋梗塞|しんきんこうそく}で{倒|たお}れた。
examples.english: My father collapsed from a heart attack.

examples.japanese: {心筋梗塞|しんきんこうそく}の{症状|しょうじょう}には{胸|むね}の{痛|いた}みがある。
examples.english: Symptoms of a heart attack include chest pain.

examples.japanese: {喫煙|きつえん}や{高血圧|こうけつあつ}は{心筋梗塞|しんきんこうそく}のリスクを{高|たか}める。
examples.english: Smoking and high blood pressure increase the risk of heart attack.

notes:
A medical compound of {心筋|しんきん} (cardiac muscle, myocardium) + {梗塞|こうそく} (infarction, blockage). A critical medical term that Japanese learners may encounter in news, health discussions, and daily life.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {急性|きゅうせい}{心筋梗塞|しんきんこうそく}: acute myocardial infarction
- {心筋梗塞|しんきんこうそく}を{起|お}こす: to have a heart attack
- {心筋梗塞|しんきんこうそく}で{亡|な}くなる: to die of a heart attack
- {心筋梗塞|しんきんこうそく}の{予防|よぼう}: prevention of heart attacks

RELATED WORDS:
- {脳梗塞|のうこうそく}: cerebral infarction, stroke — blockage of blood flow to the brain
- {狭心症|きょうしんしょう}: angina — chest pain caused by reduced blood flow to the heart, a warning sign
- {心臓発作|しんぞうほっさ}: heart attack — a more colloquial equivalent using {発作|ほっさ} (attack, seizure)
